special_situation_exclusions.coverage: Known reviewed special situations only. Remaining games have not all been screened for clock-driven attacks.
special_situation_exclusions.rule: Exclude the whole possession when identified as a clock-driven final scoring attempt at the end of a quarter. Apply regardless of goal, turnover, completion, or whether the source records a huck. Retain pull/centering labels and all original events for audit. Apply to the same comparison metrics and their denominators, including huck attempt percentage, huck timing/completion, throw counts and scoring. Never renumber later possessions.
